name: idle_natural
description: Baseline natural standing pose — both arms tweened to the snapshotted natural-pose state. The canonical via waypoint: routing through this primitive guides arms back to their arms-at-sides rest before reaching the next target.

provenance.notes: rest anchors trigger the PoseTransitionChannel to tween both arm chains toward the natural-pose snapshot captured at channel construction. This makes idle_natural a meaningful via waypoint — routing through it guides arms BACK to neutral before reaching the next target, naturally avoiding through-body slerp paths.
